model: tests/test_nefarian_phase_two_survival.py (resource-limited Monte Carlo; assumptions in its docstring)

pillar_top_separation_yards.note: nearest flat-top edges (flat radius up to 3.9); every heal reaches 40 yards, so no healer on one pillar reaches another (option B is geometrically impossible)

layout_search: The exhaustive 2/2/6 layout search of the first model (no layout materially better than the default) was not re-run on the corrected model: the coordinator stopped model refinement; the live run decides.
sensitivity_source: The second re-review's variants (GPT-6 Astra: damage reduction, mana pool, mana regeneration, Death Strike self-heal, no preparation), re-run on the corrected model with the default layout.
note: This is not a native estimate. The model's default pillar-2 death risk moves from about 4% to 75% under plausible changes of single assumptions (sensitivity_death_probability), and it does not model Blast Nova interrupts. It ranks layouts; the live run decides whether the healerless pillar is viable.
